verdict.rationale: Skyfire's docs show clear least-privilege credential issuance: API keys are scoped to a single agent (Buyer or Seller), and tokens (kya/pay/kya-pay) carry committed amounts, expiry windows, and identity-disclosure scoping so tokens can't exceed authorized funds or reveal unneeded identity fields. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and a documented fine-grained revocation API (only expiry+grace-period bounds exist).
